linkedin.title: Most news apps try to guess what you like by tracking every single click.
linkedin.body:
That approach feels invasive and often leads to an echo chamber where you only see more of the same. At Headlinne, we decided to build our feed differently. Instead of relying solely on tracking your behavior, our AI focuses on semantic understanding of the news itself.

We prioritize identifying the core topics and entities in a story. When you tell us what you care about, we match your interests to the actual substance of the reporting rather than just predicting what you might click on next. This keeps the feed broader and more relevant to your actual curiosity.

It is a subtle shift in engineering, but it makes a massive difference in the quality of your daily digest. We want to give you a full picture of the world, not just a mirror of your past habits.

instagram.title: Oil Prices, Wildfires, and Global Tension

slides.headline: Oil Prices, Wildfires, and Global Tension
slides.subtitle: Get caught up on the 5 biggest stories shaping the world today.

slides.headline: Oil Prices Could Hike Your Bills
slides.explanation: Economists warn that if oil prices climb above $100 a barrel, the Bank of England may have to raise interest rates. This could make borrowing more expensive for everyone.

slides.headline: Diplomatic Insults in Brazil
slides.explanation: Argentinian leader Javier Milei called the Brazilian president a thief and a convict while at a rally. It is a major escalation in tensions between the two South American neighbors.

slides.headline: Aviation Firms Sued Over Deportations
slides.explanation: Venezuelan men are suing two aviation companies for flying them to a notorious prison in El Salvador. The lawsuit claims their civil rights were violated during the process.

slides.headline: Myles Garrett Shines at Training Camp
slides.explanation: NFL star Myles Garrett made a strong impression on the Rams during his first day of practice. Fans are watching closely to see how he changes the team dynamic this season.

slides.headline: Heatwaves Fuel Fires Across Europe
slides.explanation: Spain and France are both battling dangerous wildfires as heatwaves sweep across the region. Leaders are warning that climate change is making these disasters harder to manage.

instagram.caption:
From rising energy costs to diplomatic spats and climate emergencies, the world is moving fast today. We have broken down the top stories so you can stay informed without the noise. Which of these headlines caught your attention the most?

slides.headline: Wall Street Looks Up as Oil Drops
slides.explanation: Futures are climbing today as oil prices fall following a pause in tensions between the U.S. and Iran. This shift has investors feeling more optimistic as they turn their attention to upcoming earnings reports and Fed news.

slides.headline: Inflation Relief Boosts Stocks and Bonds
slides.explanation: Markets are seeing a bounce back today thanks to the recent slide in oil prices. Lower energy costs are providing some much needed relief against broader inflation concerns.

slides.headline: Nvidia Eyes Massive OpenAI Project
slides.explanation: Nvidia is reportedly discussing a $250 billion guarantee to support a new OpenAI data center project. This move highlights the massive scale of investment currently flowing into AI infrastructure.

slides.headline: Primark Tries New Tactics to Compete
slides.explanation: Primark is adopting supermarket strategies to win back shoppers amid the cost of living crisis and competition from cheap online retailers. The brand is working hard to stay relevant as consumer habits change.

slides.explanation: Asian markets are trending upward ahead of major Fed announcements. Meanwhile, investor interest is high as CXMT stock makes a strong debut.
